title: Graph model
description: The typed node and edge vocabulary for the repository graph. Reserved: the graph itself is Phase 6 work, built only in response to a named symptom — kernel impact sets measurably too coarse, or context budgets blown by over-inclusive slices. The vocabulary is committed now so Phase 6 starts from a reviewed contract rather than inventing one under pressure.

growth_trigger.description: The symptom that must be observed, and recorded as an evaluation, before this is built.

provenance_required.description: Fields every edge instance must carry, so a runtime-observed edge and a statically inferred edge can coexist without being confused for one another.
